verdict.rationale: Hightouch publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document titled "Hightouch API" at api.hightouch.io/api/swagger.json, with 36 paths for syncs, models, sources and destinations. Its rendered API reference is generated from that same spec URL via Redoc. The probe 404s were only at hightouch.com paths, so they do not contradict a spec hosted on the API domain. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of downloading and using the spec, and evidence that the spec covers APIs beyond the REST resource API (e.g. the Events HTTP Tracking API).
